name: Waka Flocka Flame
sources: style-research-extended vol.1 trap — Waka Flocka Flame
notes: The Lex-Luger stadium grammar, and it is the one entry in this batch whose *fill* is the identity rather than an ornament. The research: "a machine-gun snare roll (16ths/32nds) as the primary transition device" and "long accelerating rolls" — so `snareRoll.gapProb` is 0.06, the lowest number in this batch by a distance (a roll with holes in it is not machine-gun), `descendProb` is 0.08 because it only ever builds, and `velocityRampRange` [44, 102] is the widest accelerating ramp here. Everything else is the sub: "very long-decay distorted 808 that overlaps into the next bar, minimal pitch movement, deliberately clipping the low end; the sub *is* the arrangement's weight" — `slideProb` 0.08, `distortion: heavy`, `clipping: true`, and the lowest, narrowest 808 register in the batch. Harmony is "reduced to a tonic pedal plus one neighbour chord", so `maxChords` is 2 and only i–VI and i–VII exist beside the static tonic. `melody.register` spans 38 semitones — the research's "register wide-spread (very low pad + very high bell)" — which is the widest melodic reach in the batch, against a `densityPerBar` of [2, 4] that is nearly the narrowest. ⚠ `confidence` is `medium`: the research rates this high-medium and says tempi vary track to track. ⚠ `clipping` is authored intent the sampler cannot honour yet — it is on the engine's deferral register — and it is named here rather than left out, because "deliberately clipping the low end" is the single most directly sourced sentence in the entry. INFERRED: every velocity figure, the crash/impact perc density standing in for "crash on every 4- or 8-bar boundary", and the family weights. ⚠ **A register here spanned less than an octave and has been widened.** The 808 places its root with `pitch_class_in_register`, which returns nothing — and therefore writes NO 808 at all — when the window holds no octave of the key it was asked for. An eleven-semitone window misses one pitch class entirely, so the part vanished on every seed that landed in that key. The centre of the authored range is unchanged. ⚠ `anticipationProb` raised to 0.15. With `mirror_kick` against a fully locked 808 both parts take every kick, so every bass onset lands exactly on an 808 onset — `coherence.rs` calls that one line played twice rather than two parts locking. The lock is the style and is untouched; the anticipation is what makes them two parts. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 974 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: densityRatio 0.45. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary.
